_comment: Copy into each application folder as application.json. The hook finds it by walking up from the artefact, so the deterministic layer runs with no arguments and cannot be skipped.
_authored_by_note: The vendor whose model wrote these documents. The oversight layer refuses to review with the same vendor, because a model shares its own blind spots. Set it when the pack is created.
_do_not_claim_note: Anything the cover letter concedes. A CV claiming what the letter concedes is worse than either alone.
